Bug_Title: Classes should not be compared by name
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the `hasSellByDate` method by comparing the class name of the `item` parameter with the string "Pear" instead of using the `instanceof` operator to check if the object is an instance of the `Pear` class. Similarly, in the `isList` method, the bug was embedded by comparing the class name of the `valueClass` parameter with the string "List" instead of using the `isAssignableFrom` method to check if the class is a subclass of `List`.
